candidate_relations.reason: Sarcomatoid meningioma implies meningothelial origin with sarcomatoid transformation, whereas the IHC profile (SMA+, vimentin+, desmin+, EBV-) and clinical context point to leiomyosarcoma, a smooth muscle tumor. These are distinct entities.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Sarcomatoid meningioma is a specific subtype of meningioma, not leiomyosarcoma

candidate_relations.scope_detail: SFT/HPC is a fibroblastic/perivascular tumor, not a smooth muscle tumor
